newsitem.title: USA: Marriott debuts new frequent guest program.
newsitem.headline: Marriott debuts new frequent guest program.

text.p: Marriott International Inc said on Tuesday that it introduced Marriott Rewards frequent guest program, replacing its 14-year-old Honored Guests Awards program.
The Marriott Rewards program allows its nine million members to get free hotel stays at six Marriott lodging brands representing 1,000 hotels in 30 countries, the company said.
Marriott said the program is designed to increase usage across its brands and give frequent travelers an incentive to switch from competitive offers.
Marriott Rewards formed a partnership with Ritz-Carlton hotels and resorts, enabling members to earn points at eight Ritz-Carlton properties and use their points for vacations there, Marriott said.

Also, Marriott Rewards allows members to exchange their points for frequent flyer miles miles at nine airlines and members will get bonus points for using Visa cards when they stay at Marriott hotels through November 15, 1997, the company said.
